Scenario description (narrative only – figures deliberately withheld):
• The firm enters into collateralised agreements such as “securities purchased under agreements to resell” (also called reverse repurchase agreements) and “securities borrowed”.  
• Collateralised financings include “securities sold under agreements to repurchase”, “securities loaned” and other secured financings.  
• These transactions are undertaken to facilitate client activities, invest excess cash, cover short positions and finance certain firm activities.
• Interest on collateralised agreements and financings is recognised over the life of the transaction.
• The report states that a table (not reproduced here) presents the carrying value of resale and repurchase agreements and securities borrowed and loaned for the fiscal-year ends December 2012 and December 2011.

3. resolve_to_canonical(text): resolve an arbitrary alias or text to the canonical category name.
4. get_amount_for_year(canonical_name, year): return the amount (in millions of USD) for the selected category and fiscal year.
5. calculate_difference(newer_value, older_value): subtract older value from newer value and return the result (may be negative).

Question: What was the change (in millions) of “securities purchased under agreements to resell” between 2011 and 2012?  Please provide the numeric answer only (e.g., -12345).  Use the tools as needed to find the answer.
